# `ext::bash_words` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/bash_words.lani#L4)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Allocation-free literal Bash-word measurement/decoding into caller storage. Complete and Prefix modes share one traversal; syntax, logical ranges and capacity are admitted before writes. It preserves non-UTF-8 bytes, supports literal quote/escape concatenation and explicitly rejects expansions/operators outside the documented profile. Pure contracts and a 389-record decoder/reply model execute on native Linux x86_64. This is neither shell evaluation nor the response-file grammar; the separate adapter has finite Bash 5.2/bash-completion 2.11 function and actual PTY insertion acceptance. Other shells and arbitrary expansions are outside this literal profile.
